title: FRED STLFSI4 Macro Stress Regime for VT Strategy
description: Tests 3 variants of STLFSI4-adjusted VT (expanding 75th pct threshold, binary regime switch, smooth target reduction) vs 12/VIX baseline. Key difference from K504: adaptive expanding threshold vs fixed thresholds.
conclusion: NULL at Harvey t>3.0 threshold. STLFSI4-Binary (stress→50/50 SPY/GLD) showed the best full-period Sharpe (0.466 vs baseline 0.313, DM=-2.16 p=0.031, Cross-OOS 4/5 wins) but failed Harvey t>3.0. All STLFSI4 variants slightly underperformed 12/VIX in OOS 2023-2024 (low-stress bull market). The STLFSI_Bin result is interesting but not statistically robust — the improvement comes from crisis-period GLD allocation (2007-2008, 2020) rather than systematic alpha. Extends K504's null result with adaptive thresholds. VIX remains the sufficient statistic for VT strategy design.
references: Kliesen, Owyang, Vermann (2012) 'Disentangling Diverse Measures' Fed StL Review
Harvey, Liu, Zhu (2016) '...and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns' RFS
